messages:
nina: Quick UX review — new compact card for pools where min==max. Issues: badge label, primary CTA text, ARIA for disabled state.

maria: In research ppl confuse "min==max" with an error. Suggest stronger header: 'Capacity locked' and explanatory subtext.

aj: CTA currently says 'Enable burst' which is wrong for no-burst pools. We need a single CTA that works across hosted/dedicated.

priya: Implementation note: pool.supportsBurst flag exists. Prefer keeping the CTA visible but disabled with a tooltip, not hiding it. Tooltip must be focusable.

sam: Accessibility: disabled button needs aria-disabled and aria-describedby pointing to the reason. Also SR-only copy should read: 'Autoscaling is off for this pool.'

maria: Copy proposal: header 'Capacity locked', subcopy 'Min and max equal {N} GPUs — this pool will not grow beyond {N}.', primary 'Enable autoscaling', secondary 'Edit capacity'.

nina: Add est. cost delta line if available: 'Est. \u2248 +$0.10 / hr when autoscaled' (hide for private if policy forbids).

aj: UX flow: clicking 'Enable autoscaling' triggers inline confirm bar (not full modal): 'Enable autoscaling? Pool may resize between {min} and {max}.' Confirm/Cancel. Must trap focus.

priya: Reuse inline-confirm from pool-switcher. Tooltip should close on Esc.

sam: Also bump badge contrast in dark mode. I'll add accessibility checks to QA.

maria: I'll update Figma and strings. tagging @aj for final signoff on wording.

nina: Thanks — I'll add acceptance criteria to the ticket and link the preview: https://preview.redwood.design/branch/compact-capacity-lock
